name: Spirit Trap

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text:
A spirit trap consists of a net dipped in water that has been steeped with sacred herbs to better combat phantoms. This snare's components function as a net when not set up. You set this snare up in a 10-foot-by-10-foot area. The first creature with the spirit trait that steps into the area must attempt a DC 16 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Off-Guard for 1 round.

Failure The creature is Immobilized for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is immobilized until it Escapes.
